channel.title: The Banks Post - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Banks Post (bankspost.com)

item.title: Washington County seeks input on first-ever review of land use code
item.description: Washington County is performing its first-ever comprehensive review of its Community Development Code and wants public input through April 5.

item.title: More than 2 million seedlings planted this season in Oregon's state forests
item.description: A mild winter helped the Oregon Department of Forestry plant roughly 2 million seedlings ahead of schedule, including in the Tillamook State Forest.

item.title: Drivers have two weeks to remove studded tires before April 1 deadline
item.description: Oregon drivers have two weeks to remove studded tires before the April 1 deadline or face a $165 fine.

item.title: This Week in Banks — Mar. 19–24
item.description: Banks baseball and softball kick off the week, plus Bingo, Rural Ramblers, and the Salmonberry Trail Guided Hike.

item.title: The St. Francis Steak Dinner and Antique Tractor Show returns May 2
item.description: The annual St. Francis Steak Dinner and Antique Tractor Show is set for Saturday, May 2 at St. Francis in Roy.

item.title: Column | 1976 in Banks: 'Twins at 80' from Banks, Buxton
item.description: In Banks and Buxton, twin sisters Edith Rinck and Ethel Crowther were the talk of the town on their 80th birthday. This and more in the news of the 1970s!

item.title: Banks fireworks show still needs $4,000 from sponsors
item.description: The annual Banks Fourth of July fireworks show still needs about $4,000 in sponsorships to reach its $25,000 goal, with the deadline less than two weeks away.

item.title: Banks News: St. Francis Dinner and Antique Tractor Show, fireworks show needs $4k, and more | March 20, 2026
item.description: This week: The St. Francis Steak Dinner and Antique Tractor Show returns May 2, Drivers have two weeks to remove studded tires before April 1 deadline, and more than 2 million seedlings planted this season in Oregon's state forests.

item.title: ODF sends crews to North Carolina to fight wildfires
item.description: The Oregon Department of Forestry deployed 21 firefighters and an agency representative to North Carolina over the weekend to help fight wildfires.

item.title: Banks February 2026 Police Log
item.description: A breakdown of police calls by category and an audio report as delivered to the Banks City Council meeting in March.
